Job Description

At Revelyst Adventure Sports, our purpose is to amplify Impact by bringing together iconic brands on one powerful platform. Through industry-leading brands including Fox Racing, Bell, Giro, CamelBak, and Blackburn, we create products, experiences, and innovations that inspire people to ride, race, explore, and push their limits outdoors.

We are seeking a Finance AI Process Innovation Intern to join our team for a 90-day paid summer internship beginning June 1, 2027. You will join the innovation program and will focus on improving repeatable finance processes through AI-assisted workflows, lightweight automation, analytics, and practical prototype development. The intern will partner with Finance, IT, the Program Administrator, and business subject matter experts to document current-state processes and develop governed solutions that improve accuracy, visibility, efficiency, and control.

This position reports to VP, Transformation and is based out of our Irvine, CA office.

As the Finance AI Process Innovation Intern, you will have an opportunity to: 



- Interview Finance users and process owners to understand recurring tasks, manual workflows, reporting needs, controls, inputs, outputs, systems, and decision points. 
- Document current-state and future-state workflows for budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, CapEx intake, invoice exceptions, month-end support, and financial reporting. 
- Identify opportunities where AI can extract, reconcile, classify, summarize, draft, validate, route, or automate routine finance work while maintaining human review. 
- Build proof-of-concept tools, prompts, scripts, workflows, dashboards, or lightweight applications using approved company tools and environments. 
- Work with Finance and IT to protect sensitive financial data and follow access, security, privacy, retention, audit, and role-based permission requirements. 
- Validate calculations, outputs, business rules, and usability with Finance subject matter experts and document limitations and required controls. 
- Create user documentation, solution summaries, handoff materials, and measurable benefit statements for completed prototypes. 
- Track assigned work, risks, questions, approvals, and deliverables through the approved project management process. 

You Have



- Currently pursuing a degree or recent academic experience in finance, accounting, business analytics, information systems, data analytics, economics, or a related field. 
- Interest in artificial intelligence, automation, financial analysis, business process improvement, and practical enterprise problem solving. 
- Ability to work accurately with spreadsheets, structured data, financial concepts, and process documentation. 
- Ability to learn new systems quickly and translate Finance needs into structured requirements or prototype concepts. 
- Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain analytical or technical concepts to non-technical audiences. 
- Strong attention to detail, judgment, confidentiality, accountability, and willingness to work in a cross-functional environment. 

You Might Have



- Experience with Excel, Power BI, SQL, Python, Microsoft Power Platform, VS Code, GitHub, Azure DevOps, APIs, or similar tools. 
- Exposure to budgeting, forecasting, financial reporting, variance analysis, CapEx, accounts payable, reconciliations, or management reporting. 
- Exposure to AI prompt development, workflow automation, data extraction, reporting dashboards, or prototype development. 
- Experience documenting business processes, requirements, acceptance criteria, controls, or standard operating procedures. 

Pay Range

Starting Hourly Rate: $35.00

The actual annual salary offered to a candidate will be based on variables including experience, geographic location, education, and skills/achievements, and will be mutually agreed upon at the time of offer.

We offer a highly competitive salary, comprehensive benefits including: medical and dental, vision, disability and life insurance, 401K, PTO, paid holidays, gear discounts and the ability to add value to an exciting mission!

Our Postings are not intended for distribution to or use in any jurisdiction, country or territory where such distribution or use would violate local law or would subject us to any regulations in another jurisdiction, country or territory. We reserve the right to limit our Postings in any jurisdiction, country or territory.

Equal Opportunity Employer Protected Veteran/Disabled

WD is building the infrastructure behind the AI-driven data economy.
 As AI scales, so does data. Every interaction, every model, every system generates data that must be stored, managed, and made accessible over time. That’s where we come in.
 We combine deep engineering expertise with global-scale manufacturing to deliver the storage systems that make AI possible, powering hyperscale data centers, cloud platforms, and enterprise infrastructure worldwide.
 This isn’t theoretical work. It’s real systems, at real scale, people solving some of the hardest challenges in technology today.
 We’re looking for people who want to build, solve, and operate at that level.
 Join us and let’s shape the future of data.

We’re the embedded HDD firmware crew that keeps the world’s data spinning. Our SAFe agile squads write  C++  firmware, build  Python  test tools, and dive deep into RTOS-level code that ships in enterprise-class hard-disk drives. You’ll pair up with hardware engineers, SIT, and QA partners around the globe to turn specs into rock-solid products.
 ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES: 
 
• Code that ships:  Design, code, and debug  C++  firmware running on real HDD platforms. 
• Build the toolbox:  Create  Python-based  test utilities that accelerate our CI pipeline.  
• Own the sprint:  Contribute inside a SAFe agile team—story pointing, stand-ups, demos, repeat. 
• See the system:  Explore registers, buses, and RTOS internals to hunt down bugs and optimize performance. 
• Share the story:  Document designs, results, and data insights so everyone learns. 
• Daily Programming Languages :    C++ & Python  This role is part of WD's early career development program. WD's early career development program is ideal for individuals at the early stages of their professional career.  Participants receive foundational training through structured onboarding, mentorship, and a curated development curriculum. The responsibilities of this role are typically aligned with candidates who have approximately 0–2+ years of relevant professional experience, though candidates of all experience levels are encouraged to apply.

REQUIRED 
 
• Class standing:  Currently pursuing a BS in CS, CE, EE, or similar.  
• Fluent in code: Solid projects or coursework in C++  and  Python. 
• Embedded mindset: You’ve tinkered with microcontrollers, RTOS kernels, or low-level drivers. 
• Team energy: Collaborative, curious, and comfortable asking “why?”  
• Communicator: Clear writer and speaker—because great ideas deserve great explanations. PREFERRED 
 
• Past internship or personal projects in embedded/IoT. 
• Familiarity with ESP32, I2C, SATA/SAS bus analyzers, or automated test frameworks.
